groups.emptyHint: Every staged session has either reached its minimum or been decided.
groups.forceConfirmDescription: The minimum and the deadline are ignored: deposit-paid bookings become confirmed and their balances fall due. Travellers were promised the minimum — only do this with the agency's agreement.
groups.closeDescription: The group is marked not confirmed. Deposit-paid bookings become refund-due and refund cases are created immediately; unpaid bookings are cancelled.
groups.extendDescription: The session deadline and every booking plan snapshot move together. The new deadline must be before the session start date.
groups.success: Intervention applied and recorded in the audit log.

security.mfaDescription: Admin sign-in requires a password plus a 6-digit authenticator code. Enrol an authenticator app here; re-enrolling replaces the previous secret and recovery codes.
security.noRecoveryCodesWarning: You have no recovery codes left. Re-enrol to issue a fresh set, and make sure at least one break-glass credential is active.
security.stepScan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (or type the secret manually).

security.recoveryCodesWarning: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe and offline; they cannot be shown again.
security.breakGlassDescription: A break-glass credential is a separate one-time secret for the lost-authenticator emergency: with the admin password it signs in without the TOTP code. Create one, store it offline (sealed envelope or password safe), and never keep it next to the password. Every use is audit-logged and alerts all admins.
security.breakGlassSecretWarning: Shown only now. Store it offline immediately. It expires on {{expiresAt}} and works exactly once.
